composio._comment: Composio hosted MCP (omniclaw-search server, 21 web/travel/shopping/finance/news search tools, NO_AUTH). Tools appear to the model as mcp_composio_COMPOSIO_SEARCH_*. To add more apps (Gmail/GitHub/etc): connect them in Composio under THIS api key's project, create an MCP server including their toolkits, then swap the url's server-id. The ?user_id= scopes the session per end-user. Config is read live at runtime; restart to auto-connect or call mcp_connect_all. NOTE: connect.composio.dev/mcp (Composio Connect, 1000+ apps) needs an AuthKit JWT Bearer token, NOT the raw x-api-key — so it cannot be used with just this api key.
